text:
alex: CI red on hosted-integ — auth + streaming + toolcall failing on master. Seen in shard 7. Error snippet: 'signature_verification_failed: kid mismatch (expected abc123, got def456)'. Can someone trigger a rerun or bisect? :rotating_light:

ci-bot: nightly-hosted-integ-shard-7 failed — job 49928 — https://ci.example.com/jobs/49928/artifacts

maria: thx for the heads up. pinging infra. which commit range? last green was main@a1b2c3 (2739000000)

jon: i started a quick local repro. looks like token kid rotation happened ~2739050000. Can you paste failing test request headers? logs show 'kid=def456' but JWKS cached abc123.

alex: attaching excerpt:
```
Auth: Bearer eyJhbGci... kid=def456
Received JWKS: ["abc123"]
Trace: trace/abcd-1234
```

sophia: hmm might be gateway/CDN caching old JWKS. @maria did we change jwks-cache TTL last week?

maria: checked — CDN config unchanged. carol (infra) is OOO until afternoon but looping in runtime folks. @pranav any ideas?

pranav: saw this before when control-plane rotated keys; new kid issued but some edge nodes still serve cached JWKS for ~2m. Quick mitigation: rerun with cache disabled or add retries in the test harness for 401+kid-mismatch. For immediate triage: rerun job with SKIP_CACHE=1 env var.

alex: good plan. can someone run `/rerun-job 49928 env SKIP_CACHE=1` ?

jon: done — rerun kicked (https://ci.example.com/jobs/49928). waiting :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ci-bot: job 49928 rerun started by jon — https://ci.example.com/jobs/49928

sophia: if rerun passes we should still follow up: add jwks-refresh hook to integ harness and file a bisect to find the commit that changed TTL/invalidations.

maria: rerun came back green ✅. tagging for post-mortem and bisect. alex — can you open a small PR to make the integ harness retry on 401-with-kid-mismatch?

alex: will do, PR incoming in ~30m. thx everyone :raised_hands:

jon: filing bisect ticket now, adding suspected commit range and traces.

pranav: also adding a telemetry metric for jwks-miss to help catch this automatically in future.
